cruise_back.note: v2 drawings, now an 8-step ping-pong so the sway loops without a pop.

cruise_left.note: NEW: replaces the v1 skate_left still. Knee-bend sway loop; magenta patch on his left (near) side.

cruise_right.note: NEW: replaces the v1 skate_right still. No magenta patch visible (it is on his far side).

cruise_front.note: NEW: replaces the v1 skate_front still. Board end-on toward camera. Frames 0 and 2 of the strip rejected (diagonal board / turned crouch).

push_back.note: v5-push. Same stroke as v4 (plant beside the rear wheels, drag, toe-off, low recovery). The dip/lean is now eased: head moves at most 8px between frames (v4 jumped 23px at 1->2 and 5->6). The board is widened to match the v3 board.

push_back_left.note: v5-push. Same stroke as v4. The torso drift is reduced and eased (head x 256->272->260; v4 went to 291 and snapped back 33px at the loop). The plant is still beside/behind the deck, not up by the front trucks.

push_back_right.note: v5-push. New plant frames: the push foot swings in and plants on the ground in front of the tail beside the rear wheel (near side), drags back behind the tail, toe-off, extends, lifts. Built by rotating the lower leg about the knee from a clean v4 frame (the generator kept putting it behind the tail). v3 white blob removed from frame 0; no double boards.

push_left.note: v5-push. New plant frames: the push foot plants on the far side of the board between the wheels (shoe seen above the deck and under it between the wheels), then drags back behind the tail, extends, lifts. Built by rotating the whole push leg about the hip from a v4 frame.

push_right.note: v5-push. Redrawn with a committed push: deep front-knee bend and forward lean (new render family; the body was dropped 17px so the front shoe sits on the deck). The plant is on the ground beside the rear truck on the near side, built by rotating the push leg about the hip. Frames 1 and 7 ease the crouch in and out.

push_front.note: v5-push. Built directly from the v3 cruise_front_00 frame, so the board is pixel-identical to cruise frame 0 (no pop). Only the push leg moves: lift, plant on the ground line beside the board's rear end, drag back behind the deck, lift behind, return. The deck under the lifted shoe is inpainted.

walk_front.note: REDONE: 8 steps, both feet alternate: passing (left knee up), left-foot contact, down, cross, right-foot contact, down, passing, up. Right-foot steps flip ONLY the legs below the jacket hem; torso, chest patch and board are never mirrored.

walk_left.note: REDONE: 8 steps with a real passing pose (knee lifted, foot off the ground) and an up pose between strides. Same leg leads each contact (generator would not alternate in profile).

walk_right.note: REDONE: 8 steps with passing (knee lifted) and up poses between strides.

kickup_right.note: NEW: ride, step off, tail stomp, board vertical, catch, tuck. A duplicate board the generator drew under his feet in frames 3-5 was erased by hand.

dropin_right.note: NEW: hold, lower, step on, both feet, push, roll. v3a rejected (two boards in frame 2).

ollie_back.note: REDONE: board is now end-on (pointing along his travel line) and level in every air frame. Body from a v3 render; its sideways deck was replaced with the end-on deck/trucks/wheels cut from the approved cruise_back art.

ollie_back_left.note: NEW: board points upper-left along travel. Strip frame 2 rejected (board on the wrong diagonal).

ollie_back_right.note: NEW: board points upper-right along travel in every frame.

kickflip_left.note: NEW: profile kickflip, board shows edge then wooden underside then grip.

grab_back.note: REDONE: 6 frames (was 4): crouch, pop, reach, grab, hold, release to an end-on landing. Board is tweaked diagonally while grabbed.

grab_left.note: NEW: profile indy grab facing left.

grab_right.note: NEW: profile indy grab facing right, hand on the board in frames 2-4.

grind_right.note: NEW: right-facing 50-50 with sparks (no more patch-wrong fallback to grind_left). v3a rejected: magenta patch on his right chest.

bail_front.note: REDONE: 6 frames (was 1): board slips out, tip back, stumble, sit-fall, wince, get up on one knee.

atlas.note: atlas_rect is the trimmed frame; anchor_offset is that rect's top-left relative to the shared ground anchor, in atlas pixels (y down). Frames that reuse a drawing share one rect. Push cycles replaced by v5-push; other drawings are the v3 pixels.
